absent: Grace period start, propagation, wait and end protocol beyond snapshot and cleanup helpers.
Callback enqueue, segregation, advancement and invocation paths.
Read side enter, exit, boost and preempt handling beyond softirq quiescent hook.
Tree topology construction, CPU hotplug integration and node locking hierarchy.
Expedited, polled and tasks grace mechanisms beyond sequence accessors.
No callback offload thread lifecycle beyond deferred wakeup check.
Force quiescent and stall detection tuning beyond timing globals and recheck escalation.

findings.text: Softirq quiescent reporting records a quiescent state for the current CPU outside read side sections, warns if invoked while holding read side state, then advances core, preempt deferred and tasks quiescent handling.

Current grace sequence and expedited batch count are readable through lightweight accessors, and torture helpers expose flags with current sequence plus packed and formatted views combining normal, expedited and polled counters.

Interrupt work reschedule hook runs without instrumentation, ignores virtual CPU configurations, attempts a deferred no callback wakeup, and queues per CPU late wakeup work when a reschedule is pending.

Interrupt exit and entry checks validate nesting depth and watching state with complaints on misuse, and the entry check enables the tick dependency for full nohz CPUs that have an urgent quiescent need.
CPU need check reports true only when the local callback list is non empty and the local data is not offloaded.

Global state begins idle with root level linkage, a grace sequence biased below zero, a fixed name and abbreviation, initialized barrier and expedited mutexes, raw barrier lock, offline lock, and a cleanup work item with zero pending cleanups.

Topology and mode controls comprise fanout exactness and leaf size, level count and per level population, total node count, scheduler active flags, boost thread priority, debug tree dumping, softirq use, and several preinit, init, cleanup, nohz patience and unlock debug delays.

Default callback batch limit is 1000 under strict grace periods and 10 otherwise, with absolute maximum 10000, high watermark 10000 that bypasses the batch limit, low watermark 100 that reenables it, overload multiplier 2 yielding overload threshold 20000 that triggers quiescent hammering, and uninitialized overload marker negative one.
Debug pacing uses 3 grace periods per node, synchronize latch threshold uses 64, default irq stat accounting reports 0, and reschedule delay uses 3 milliseconds.

Force quiescent timing starts with first delay zero under strict grace periods and maximal otherwise, next delay maximal, kthread kicking disabled, divisor 7, sched quiescent delay maximal and its derived timeout initially zero.
First and next force quiescent parameters accept tick values, clamp them to at most one second and at least one tick respectively, store them once, and refresh derived sched quiescent timing.

Deferred no callback wakeup checks a level threshold without locking, then under the group lock rechecks and wakes the grace period thread with tracing, releasing the lock on both paths; the alternate configuration reports no wakeup ever needed.
Urgent tick enable for full nohz CPUs reevaluates need flags while holding the node lock, which is safe in interrupt context because interrupts are disabled and watching state is already active.

Zero in extended quiescent check samples remote watching state, orders against a polled value with barriers, fails on nonzero, then succeeds only if watching state is unchanged, preventing false quiescent attribution across state changes.

Idle interrupt classifier uses nesting depth to separate nested non idle interrupts, single level idle interrupts from non watching regions, task context evaluated by watching state, and underflow warnings, requiring disabled interrupts.
Watching snapshot save uses acquire ordering when recording remote watching state and treats an idle snapshot as an acknowledged quiescent state with overflow accounting.

Snapshot recheck first accepts stopped or re entered idle, warns and releases offline CPUs, then escalates from urgent to heavy quiescent requests with age, hammers full nohz and lagging CPUs with reschedules and irq work, and captures stall accounting once per grace period.

Grace wrap lag defaults to one quarter of the sequence space and can be reset from a grace count shift, while future cleanup reports whether needed sequence is beyond current and clamps the needed value when caught up to avoid wrap.

Slow grace suppression is published through a single atomic pointer with warnings on duplicate registration or mismatched unregistration, and the slow path only delays when unsuppressed, positive, and aligned to node count pacing.
Torture wait consumes a one shot jiffy duration only when torture is enabled and otherwise does nothing, while the strict boundary helper simply triggers core processing.
Synchronize wait head pool is a fixed array in global state with atomic usage flags, membership determined by address range, atomic claim on acquire and atomic clear on release.

Normal synchronize completion verifies full grace passage when proof is enabled, completes the waiter, decrements the outstanding count and unlatches when drained; cleanup work detaches the done chain under acquire semantics, completes requests, recycles wait heads, and releases the pending count.
Watching online enable is idempotent and late wakeup uses per CPU empty irq work as a deferred reschedule placeholder.
